description: Plan de voirie - Mobiliers urbains - Kiosques - Toilettes publiques - Panneaux publicitaires is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Concessions - Kiosque à journaux - Poteau d'affichage - Mobilier urbain d'information - Cabine téléphonique multimédia - Journaux lumineux - Sanisette - Pompe à essence - Colonne d'affichage - Mat porte affiches - Boite aux lettres - Armoire postale Le Plan de Voirie de Paris: Le Plan de Voirie de Paris (PVP) est destiné à ... Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are Mobilier urbain, concessions, PVP, DVD. The portal shows 94,456 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
